title: Kirby Problem 1.40
exact_target: Test injectivity of satellite operators, classify those that are homomorphisms, and ask how large the image of every nonconstant winding-zero operator must be.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2699 (KP-1.40). CC BY 4.0.
